title: Lodge a residential tenancy complaint with NSW Fair Trading
summary: If you cannot resolve a tenancy dispute privately, you can lodge a complaint with NSW Fair Trading, which will act as an informal negotiator.
intro:
Tenants and landlords or property managers should try to resolve disputes between themselves if possible. If you cannot resolve the issue privately you can lodge a complaint with NSW Fair Trading. Fair Trading will act as an informal negotiator between the parties. There's no fee for this service.

Before you lodge a complaint, check the types of tenancy problems Fair Trading can assist with. They can help with some but not all tenancy matters.
who_can_apply: Tenants, landlords, or property managers who have been unable to reach an agreement over a tenancy dispute.
what_you_need: Name and contact details of the tenant, landlord, or property manager you are complaining about.
Details of the dispute and your attempt to resolve the issue.
Copies of any relevant documents such as correspondence, condition reports, bank statements, or photos.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Property Complaint Form – PDF.
Lodge your complaint by mail or email, to the details on the form.

more_info.text: After receiving your complaint, NSW Fair Trading will attempt to finalise the matter within 30 days.
If there is no resolution from the NSW Fair Trading intervention, they'll advise you of further action you can take.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to lodge a tenancy complaint?
faqs.a: No, there is no fee for this service.
